record.dic_text:
05910 `Akkow {ak-ko'}

字根似乎已不使用, 意指"包圍"; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Accho 1; 1

亞柯 = "他的狹隘"
1) 一個位於亞設的海港市鎮, 在迦密山的北方和推羅的南方  （#士 1:31|）
record.edic_text:
05910 `Akkow {ak-ko'}

apparently from an unused root meaning to hem in;; n pr loc

AV - Accho 1; 1

Accho = "his straitness"
1) a seaport town in Asher north of Mount Carmel and south or Tyre
